### Goal
Fix the Quebec provincial tax (QST) calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py` with minimal regression coverage. Invoice tracing/histogram and OpenTelemetry work remain deferred.

### Constraints and rules
Avoid unrelated billing changes. Do not write to frozen schema `billing_v1`; active schema is `billing_v3`. Never edit `docs/CHANGELOG.md` on Fridays without proposed-entry approval from @priya in `#ledgerly-releases`. Run webhook cutover commands individually in order and verify gap-free replay. Report exact test output.

### Key decisions and facts
Search rebuilds use tenant scoping, shared embeddings, bounded concurrency/chunks of 100, and bulk vector upserts. CSV reports explicitly use UTF-8. `build_invoice_lines` now returns a concrete `list[LineItem]`; invoice helper annotations were added without changing behavior.

### Ruled out
Do not pin `httpx` to 0.23; it broke Stripe. Do not modify frozen `billing_v1` or pursue deferred telemetry work.

### Progress
CSV fix is complete: exporter and test changed, Ruff and `git diff --check` passed, full suite was `186 passed, 3 skipped`; focused CSV tests previously passed (`8 passed`) and exporter suite (`24 passed`). Invoice tests passed twice (`12 passed`); `mypy` identified the generator/list return mismatch, fixed by returning `list(...)`. Webhook replay job completed, but logs and gap-free verification remain outstanding.

### Next steps
Inspect Quebec tax code/tests, reproduce the QST bug, implement the minimal fix and regression test, then run focused/full tests and lint. Complete webhook log inspection and replay-gap verification.
